images.title: The Last Judgment
images.creator: Unknown icon painter
images.collection: Russian icon collection of the Déjà Vu art gallery (as recorded in the source description)
images.alt: A large eighteenth-century Russian icon of the Last Judgment with registers of saints, angels, scales, a river of fire and scenes of punishment
images.note: The source description states the icon is typical of mid-to-late eighteenth-century iconography and was influenced by printed engravings, which is the basis for the atlas’s remark about printed-page layouts.
